ac.1_simulate_rule_set_has_7_new_fields: Already present in _simulate_rule_set_entries return dict (verified); no changes needed to cpu_engine.py
ac.5_execution_ok_true: `execution_ok(...)` returns True when skip ratio ≤ 0.20 and exec ratio ≥ 0.60
ac.7_phase3_score_subtracts_penalty: Penalty wired into _robust_combo_return via evaluator_health_penalty(train) + evaluator_health_penalty(val) × PHASE3_EVAL_HEALTH_WEIGHT
ac.8_phase4_trial_subtracts_penalty: Penalty wired into Phase 4 Optuna objective via evaluator_health_penalty(val_metrics) × PHASE3_EVAL_HEALTH_WEIGHT
ac.9_gate_wired: gate_positive_good calls execution_ok when require_execution_health=True (all 4 call sites in phase3_rule_set.py pass config flag PHASE3_GATE_EXECUTION_HEALTH)

notes_for_reviewer: cpu_engine.py `_simulate_rule_set_entries` already exposes all 7 fields (raw_signal_count, executed_trades, skipped_min_notional_count, max_simultaneous_positions, max_total_open_exposure, loss_count, time_closed_count, account_ruined). No changes needed there.

gate_positive_good got a new keyword argument `require_execution_health=False` (default) for backward compat with existing tests. All 4 internal call sites pass the config flag PHASE3_GATE_EXECUTION_HEALTH (default True).
Phase 4 evaluator health penalty requires one extra backtest per trial on the full val_df. This is O(1) per trial and mirrors how monthly penalty is computed.

8 new config keys added with EVAL_HEALTH_ prefix (to avoid collision with friend's RB_ prefix): EVAL_HEALTH_MAX_SKIPPED_RATIO, EVAL_HEALTH_MIN_EXECUTED_RATIO, EVAL_HEALTH_SKIPPED_WEIGHT, EVAL_HEALTH_EXECUTED_WEIGHT, EVAL_HEALTH_MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_POSITIONS, EVAL_HEALTH_MAX_POSITIONS_WEIGHT, PHASE3_EVAL_HEALTH_WEIGHT, PHASE3_GATE_EXECUTION_HEALTH.
No changes to GPU engine, evaluator_v5.ipynb, or existing JSON output contract.
